title: robbietilton/Compositor
why_read: A native Mac image-editing app positioned as a Photoshop alternative, of interest to those wanting non-Adobe creative tools.
analysis: Compositor appears to be a Swift-based, presumably native macOS image editor aiming to replace Adobe Photoshop for at least some use cases. Without more detail on feature parity, performance, or file-format support, it's hard to assess how complete or capable it actually is versus existing alternatives like Affinity Photo or Pixelmator. Still, a from-scratch native Mac app in this space is a nontrivial undertaking and the strong star count suggests real community interest.
